_comment: Agent-operable stewardship map for the public packages that turn HoloScript into a universal construction substrate for humans and AI agents.
principles: Every stewarded package names the construction capability it gives to humans and AI agents.
Every fleet or release package has a runnable validation path before an agent claims improvement.
Stewardship expands existing packages first; new packages need an explicit construction role and consumer lane.
Next actions, blockers, and caveats must be separate so agents know what to build, what to unblock, and what not to overclaim.

packages.constructionRole: Language substrate: parser, AST, traits, compilers, and runtime APIs.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep the core package the smallest complete construction kernel that every higher package can depend on cold.
nextActions: Keep public exports cold-installable and covered by check:registry-cold-start:core.
Promote new language primitives only when they are source-level and gate-verifiable.

packages.constructionRole: Legacy compatibility shim for older Smart Asset and HoloHub-client JavaScript consumers.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep the published shim importable for existing users while preventing it from becoming a renewed primary SDK surface.

reason: The package manifest deprecates @holoscript/sdk as a primary SDK and identifies @holoscript/core as the canonical replacement.
Current source exports only Smart Asset schema and HoloHub-client compatibility APIs, not the full construction surface.
The package remains published and importable for older consumers, but new parser, compiler, scene, and trait work belongs in @holoscript/core.
promotionCriteria: Do not promote this package; any renewed SDK strategy must be a fresh deliberate product decision with package-consumption and cold-start proof.
Keep compatibility imports green until a future major removal or deprecation campaign retires the shim.

caveats.summary: @holoscript/sdk is a legacy compatibility shim, not the canonical SDK for new HoloScript construction.
caveats.overclaimGuard: Point new users and agents to @holoscript/core, @holoscript/cli, @holoscript/mcp-server, and package-specific surfaces instead of expanding this shim.

nextActions: Keep @holoscript/sdk@latest importable through the sdk-compat-import registry cold-start probe.
Do not add new platform features here; route new construction APIs to @holoscript/core or a deliberately stewarded package.

packages.constructionRole: Agent tool gateway: MCP entrypoints, sizing profiles, and fleet dispatch tools.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep MCP the universal agent access layer across laptop, Jetson, Vast, and hosted coordinators.
nextActions: Keep sizing profiles aligned with laptop, Jetson, Vast, and fleet hosted lanes.
Make new MCP tools discoverable, authenticated, and tied to package consumption checks.

packages.constructionRole: Native local-LLM serving: llama.cpp planning, lifecycle receipts, and HoloMesh read-only bridge.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make HoloLlama the owned-metal inference package for Laptop, Jetson, and Vast rather than an Ollama-dependent side path.

blockers.summary: No configured Vast HoloLlama endpoint is available in the local validation environment, so Vast live-service receipt promotion cannot honestly close.
blockers.nextUnblockAction: Set HOLOLLAMA_VAST_ENDPOINT or VAST_HOLOLLAMA_ENDPOINT to a real OpenAI-compatible HoloLlama Vast endpoint, then require vast-linux-gpu in check-holollama-live-fleet.

caveats.summary: The Jetson live-service gate proves endpoint health, model discovery, and a tiny completion; always-on service and footprint checks may still be skipped for a laptop-side probe.
caveats.overclaimGuard: Do not claim full Jetson appliance health until the live lifecycle is run with systemd and footprint requirements enabled on the target node.

caveats.summary: @holoscript/holollama does not ship llama.cpp binaries, model weights, LoRA adapters, or private fleet credentials.
caveats.overclaimGuard: Describe npm installation as the operating surface for plans, harnesses, and receipts, not as a complete model deployment by itself.

nextActions: Keep @holoscript/holollama@0.2.x cold-installable as the owned-metal inference package for laptop, Jetson, and Vast lanes.
Keep the published CLI harness command covered by the holollama-harness registry cold-start probe.
Keep Jetson live-service receipts collected through check-holollama-live-fleet with the live-lifecycle stage passing.
Set HOLOLLAMA_VAST_ENDPOINT or VAST_HOLOLLAMA_ENDPOINT before requiring Vast live-service receipt promotion.

packages.constructionRole: Headless agent runtime for unattended HoloMesh work.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Give every compute lane a packageable agent process that can run work without provider custody.
nextActions: Keep CLI entrypoints installable from a packed tarball.
Tie new agent runtime features to room, cost, and identity receipts.

packages.constructionRole: Shared identity-keyed memory client for cross-family agents.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Prevent memory from becoming a provider-specific lane by keeping the client package consumable everywhere.
nextActions: Keep the package small enough for edge and worker lanes.
Add receipts for read/write behavior before broadening public APIs.

packages.constructionRole: Human and agent command line for parse, validate, compile, and local authoring.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make source authoring available from every machine before specialized Studio surfaces are required.

blockers.summary: @holoscript/cli@8.0.11 installs from npm with holo, holoscript, and hs bins, resolves @holoscript/formatter@6.0.4, and the repo-less cli-bin-help canary verifies the help banner reports v8.0.11.

nextActions: Keep holo, holoscript, and hs bins stable across OS lanes.
Keep cli-bin-help and formatter cold-start probes green after CLI or formatter publishes.
Expose new construction workflows through source-first commands.

packages.constructionRole: Standalone formatter and formatting library for .holo, .hs, and .hsplus source.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep source hygiene and CLI transitive dependencies cold-installable outside the monorepo.
nextActions: Keep holoscript-format help and import cold-start probes green after each formatter publish.
Use formatter cold-start failures as release-blocking evidence for CLI and VS Code package work.
Promote richer formatting behavior only through tests and package-consumption proof.

packages.constructionRole: Embodiment package for user locomotion and agent-NPC avatars.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep shared worlds consumable as package code instead of one-off scene demos.
nextActions: Keep React and three entrypoints optional where possible.
Add focused consumption examples for HoloLand and HoloShell clients.

packages.constructionRole: Spatial engine runtime for rendering, physics, animation, ECS, GPU, and simulation subsystems.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep high-churn engine capabilities packageable without letting native, browser, or benchmark surfaces leak into cold consumers.
nextActions: Keep engine-runtime-import green from a repo-less npm consumer before each engine publish.
Decide whether engine should become fleet-operational after browser and native optional dependency behavior is covered by narrower runtime probes.

packages.constructionRole: Agent framework for board, behavior, economy, swarm, learning, and skill orchestration.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep multi-agent framework APIs publishable and consumable without coupling them to a single provider harness.
nextActions: Keep framework-agent-import green from a repo-less npm consumer before each framework publish.
Keep cloud-family harness adapters outside the core framework package boundary.

packages.constructionRole: Platform layer for security, web3, identity, registry, and enterprise integration.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make HoloKey, x402, and registry platform capabilities packageable without leaking deployment secrets.
nextActions: Add a secret-safe HoloKey/x402 import smoke before promoting platform into package-consumption.
Keep hosted-service configuration documented without embedding private deployment paths or keys.

packages.constructionRole: Codebase intelligence and recursive self-improvement service for Absorb, graph, and daemon workflows.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep Absorb/GraphRAG service capabilities publishable as package code while the private knowledge stores remain sovereign.
nextActions: Keep absorb-service-import green from a repo-less npm consumer without private graph credentials before each absorb-service publish.
Add narrower public API probes before treating absorb-service as fleet-operational.
Separate public package API checks from private GraphRAG corpus and OAuth state.

packages.constructionRole: Unified LLM provider SDK for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, xAI, and local adapters.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep provider routing portable while secrets and model custody stay outside the package artifact.
nextActions: Add a no-secret import smoke that verifies provider factories without touching live API keys.
Keep local-LLM adapter strategy aligned with HoloLlama rather than reintroducing Ollama dependency assumptions.

packages.constructionRole: React Three Fiber renderer package for HoloScript visual and spatial app clients.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep renderer components reusable without making React/Three client code a requirement for core language consumers.
nextActions: Add a package-consumption smoke that imports renderer components without a browser runtime.
Keep visual client examples separate from package entrypoint guarantees.

packages.constructionRole: Private Studio app shell for AI-powered 3D scene building and package-driven authoring workflows.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep Studio strategically connected to public packages while preventing founder paths, private services, or hosted config from becoming a public artifact.
nextActions: Keep Studio private until public-package entrypoints cover the reusable authoring APIs.
Extract reusable Studio capabilities into package surfaces before publishing any app shell.

packages.constructionRole: Template for turning domain knowledge into reusable HoloScript plugin packages.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make domain expansion repeatable for agents and human package authors without forking core.
nextActions: Promote a template smoke test into the package consumption matrix.
Keep plugin author instructions source-first and free of private founder paths.

packages.constructionRole: Parked experimental CPU decoder seed for sovereign HoloRunner checkpoints.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep this as a version-policy-managed research package until it has a public tokenizer bridge and cold-consume proof.

reason: The default tokenizer bridge resolves HOLOAI_ECOSYSTEM_ROOT or ~/.ai-ecosystem, so a clean npm consumer does not yet have the tokenizer module by default.
No package-consumption or cold-start matrix row proves the package on laptop, Jetson, and Vast.
No fleet utility class consumes this decoder directly; the current @model_fleet node is a research seed, not an operational utility lane.
promotionCriteria: Ship or parameterize a public tokenizer bridge so clean npm consumers do not need the private academy repo.
Add npm pack, cold import, and package-consumption checks for laptop-windows, jetson-orin, and vast-linux-gpu.
Add a fleet utility map row only after a concrete laptop, Jetson, or Vast consumer uses this decoder as an operational utility.

nextActions: Do not add @holoscript/holo-runtime to the npm v1 release manifest, package-consumption matrix, or fleet utility map until the parkingDecision.promotionCriteria are met.
Keep build/test and version-policy checks green while the tokenizer bridge and real model-fleet consumer mature.

packages.constructionRole: Cognition substrate: uAA2++ VM plus packageable uAAL v2 semantic recognizers for world-model and theory-of-mind gates.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep uAAL as the shared package surface for semantic corpus, held-out, producibility, and training receipts instead of letting private scripts copy recognizer logic.

blockers.summary: The uAAL package and gates prove producible semantic IR, but they do not prove that the S0 student has learned the target distribution.
blockers.nextUnblockAction: Run the private S0 training lane consuming @holoscript/uaal package APIs and attach receipt-level package provenance.

caveats.summary: The public package should expose recognizers and structural gates while private corpus generators remain outside the published artifact.
caveats.overclaimGuard: Do not publish generator templates that would collapse held-out integrity or imply the public package includes the sovereign corpus.

nextActions: Keep semantic verticals importable from @holoscript/uaal/semantic and the structural spec importable from @holoscript/uaal/gate before folding private corpora.
Make private corpus, held-out, producibility, and S0 training lanes consume the package API with receipt-level package provenance.

packages.constructionRole: Python bindings for scripting, robotics, and scientific construction lanes.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Make Python a first-class HoloScript consumption lane without splitting the source of truth.

caveats.summary: The PyPI live smoke proves published wheel installation and imports from a fresh virtualenv, not robotics, Jetson utilization, or GPU workload performance.
caveats.overclaimGuard: Keep hardware claims tied to separate target-node receipts instead of PyPI install logs.

nextActions: Keep fleetLifecycle checks verified for build, artifact inspection, fresh-venv smoke, live PyPI audit, extras resolution, and published-wheel smoke.
Add examples that round-trip HoloScript source through Python without creating a parallel language.

packages.constructionRole: Python trait inference utility for model-assisted source construction.
packages.stewardshipIntent: Keep ML-assisted trait inference packageable and smokeable without making it required for core use.

caveats.summary: The Vast model extra is resolver-checked and published-wheel smoke-tested, but the model workload itself is still optional and not run during package stewardship.
caveats.overclaimGuard: Do not claim GPU model accuracy or throughput from resolver and import smokes; require evaluator receipts for that.

nextActions: Keep the model extra Vast-oriented and lifecycle-scoped through pip dry-run resolution rather than mandatory laptop or Jetson installs.
Add evaluator receipts before promoting new inference capabilities into core workflows.
